development_data: BIRDSAI TrainReal track-disjoint validation only for Step18A diagnostic evaluation.
direction_rule: For each boundary, the current side of the last observed position is treated as the safe side; the opposite side is the virtual risk zone.
eligibility_rule: Exactly one directional instance per axis-threshold pair, except exact boundary ties.
ensemble: arithmetic mean of frozen seed predictions
prediction_score: Maximum directional signed boundary penetration of the frozen 3-seed ensemble-mean forecast.
threshold_selection: No performance-based warning-threshold tuning. Zero is fixed by boundary-crossing semantics.
true_crossing_rule: At least one ground-truth future point reaches or crosses the virtual risk side.
tte_rule: First future timestep at which trajectory reaches or crosses the boundary.
